guideline_name: 2021 AHA/ACC/ASE/CHEST/SAEM/SCCT/SCMR Guideline for the Evaluation and Diagnosis of Chest Pain
journal: Circulation / Journal of the American College of Cardiology

key_recommendations.rationale: Early recognition of STEMI improves outcomes
Primary PCI is preferred reperfusion strategy
High-sensitivity troponin improves detection of myocardial injury

key_quotes.ecg_10min: The 12-lead ECG, which should be acquired and interpreted within 10 minutes of arrival to a medical facility, is pivotal in the evaluation because of its capacity to identify and triage patients with STEMI to urgent coronary reperfusion.
key_quotes.ecg_rationale: Early recognition of STEMI improves outcomes. Therefore, regardless of the setting, an ECG should be obtained and interpreted within 10 minutes of arrival. If this cannot be achieved in the office setting, immediate transfer to the ED by EMS is recommended.

branches.action: HEART score, serial troponin, stress testing/CTA

class_definitions.I: Benefit >>> Risk. Procedure/treatment SHOULD be performed/administered
class_definitions.IIa: Benefit >> Risk. It is REASONABLE to perform procedure/administer treatment
class_definitions.IIb: Benefit ≥ Risk. Procedure/treatment MAY BE CONSIDERED
class_definitions.III: Risk ≥ Benefit. Procedure/treatment should NOT be performed/administered

loe_definitions.A: High-quality evidence from more than 1 RCT or meta-analyses
loe_definitions.B-R: Moderate-quality evidence from 1 or more RCTs
loe_definitions.B-NR: Moderate-quality evidence from 1 or more well-designed nonrandomized studies
loe_definitions.C-LD: Randomized or nonrandomized observational or registry studies with limitations of design or execution
loe_definitions.C-EO: Consensus of expert opinion based on clinical experience
